name: Vishakumbha
description: Supportive and triumphant in outcome, but its early portion is considered inauspicious; good for overcoming obstacles once it has matured.

name: Preeti
description: A joyful, affectionate yoga favourable for love, friendship and pleasant undertakings.

name: Aayushman
description: Bestows health, vitality and longevity; auspicious for matters concerning well-being.

name: Saubhagya
description: Brings prosperity and good fortune; excellent for auspicious ceremonies and new ventures.

name: Shobhana
description: Radiant and beautiful; favourable for celebrations, marriage and anything seeking splendour.

name: Atiganda
description: Associated with danger and obstacles; best avoided for important or risky undertakings.

name: Sukarma
description: Encourages good and plentiful work; auspicious for noble deeds and charitable acts.

name: Dhriti
description: Grants determination and enjoyment; favourable for tasks needing patience and resolve.

name: Shoola
description: Sharp and quarrelsome in nature; inauspicious for negotiations and harmony-seeking work.

name: Ganda
description: Brings worry and difficulty; an inauspicious yoga to be avoided for important beginnings.

name: Vriddhi
description: Promotes growth, increase and perspicacity; excellent for investments and expansion.

name: Dhruva
description: Persistent and dependable; favourable for lasting commitments and foundation-laying.

name: Vyaghaata
description: Forceful and destructive; inauspicious, best avoided for peaceful or delicate matters.

name: Harshana
description: Brings joy and delight; auspicious for happy occasions and learning.

name: Vajra
description: A burst of hard, unpredictable energy; generally inauspicious despite its strength.

name: Siddhi
description: Grants success and accomplishment; highly auspicious for completing important goals.

name: Vyatipaata
description: One of the most inauspicious yogas, linked to calamity; avoid all important undertakings.

name: Variyaana
description: Brings ease and luxurious comfort; favourable for rest, pleasure and indulgent activities.

name: Parigha
description: Creates hindrance and resistance; inauspicious for anything requiring smooth progress.

name: Shiva
description: Benevolent and gracious; highly auspicious for worship, spiritual and noble pursuits.

name: Siddha
description: Skilled and accomplished; auspicious for ceremonies, learning and skilled work.

name: Saaddhya
description: Favours that which can be accomplished through cooperation and mediation.

name: Shubha
description: Wholly favourable; excellent for all auspicious and beneficial activities.

name: Shukla
description: Bright and focused; auspicious for clarity of purpose and creative endeavours.

name: Brahma
description: Sacred and responsible; highly auspicious for spiritual practice and important duties.

name: Indra
description: Confers leadership and authority; auspicious for taking charge and headship roles.

name: Vaidhriti
description: Divisive and separating in effect; an inauspicious yoga to be avoided for unifying work.
